The '''karabbac''' was a deadly predator from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] that largely lived in the [[Water/Legends|icy]] landmass known as [[Grendaju]]. The [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] hunted karabbac to make clothing out of their skin and masks out of their skulls.
